company.name: Verifiable
company.shortDescription: Verifiable develops real-time credential verification platform intended to verify licenses, sanctions, and other important records.
company.description:
Verifiable is developing an API that will enable healthcare providers to simplify license authentication by connecting with state and federal databases. Verifiable allows users to reach hundreds of primary sources in one location, as well as next-generation tracking that automates compliance, reduces risk, and keeps patients safe.

Founded by Nicholas Macarioand Vivekanand Rajkumar in the year 2019 and is based in San Francisco, California, United States.

productsAndServices.description: Software for automating healthcare provider credentialing, including provider applications, primary source verification, workflow management, and credentialing packet generation.
productsAndServices.name: Credentialing Software

productsAndServices.description: An autonomous AI agent for processing healthcare credentialing tasks in batches, validating provider data, documenting verification decisions, and applying configured governance rules.
productsAndServices.name: CredAgent™

productsAndServices.description: Technology-enabled credentialing services that combine automated verifications, human file review, packet preparation, credentialing support, and audit assistance for healthcare organizations.

productsAndServices.description: Continuous monitoring for provider licenses, sanctions, exclusions, adverse actions, and other compliance signals, with alerts, match review, intervention workflows, and reporting.
productsAndServices.name: Provider Network Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: Real-time verification of provider licenses, identifiers, sanctions, exclusions, disciplinary actions, and related credentials using direct connections to authoritative data sources.
productsAndServices.name: Primary Source Verification
